display_name: Source held-out-time blind operator refinement diagnostic
description: Assess whether a small bounded complex FIR can correct source blind action errors on held-out time samples; diagnostic only, no target test.

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: Fixed source IQ, independent posterior initial state and three alternative three-step paths
data.tx_sets_ref: No source true identity labels, simulated channel truth, U_s truth, V or test in this validation; clean-F pseudo labels only

permissions.query_use: Fixed previously explored impaired source received and paired clean IQ for oracle diagnosis, ungated blind parent for candidate coefficient fit; no identity truth, U_s truth, V or test.
permissions.claim_scope: Paired clean IQ is diagnostic oracle only; even/odd time samples are correlated, source records previously explored, no deployment or ground accuracy claim.

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen source-only blind action and source Gaussian prior; no DURA, no denoising prior, no F, no model update.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source blind action 94693a342bb2daa684c0f21415d7b949f9fb2107; exact 2048 source cohort SHA c600e6331b6ffef2820e4117b7eef9a946401dc314012a85c06dba73bb209c08.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed source cohort, five complex taps, ridge alpha .1, L2 correction cap .25, alternating even/odd fit and holdout; no candidate selection or target.

metric_names: held-out-time normalized observation residual with original blind A applied to paired clean IQ
same residual after blind estimated and oracle fitted bounded FIR action corrections
fit coefficient norms and held-out parent observation residual
dimensions: RX4/6, RX8 and six simulated impaired source scenes, even/odd cross validation
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Oracle fits on paired clean source IQ only to diagnose feasibility; blind fit uses observed IQ and blind-parent forward prediction, evaluated against paired clean action on held-out times. Correlated held-out times and noise prevent causal claims.

rows.method: bounded complex-FIR source action refinement diagnostic
rows.purpose: test whether updating independent blind observation model can reduce unseen-time residual
rows.seed_notes: Prior model seed 2026125054; fixed final epoch8; no source validation training.
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes

notes: No DURA architecture, checkpoint, teacher, comparator or inference; frozen source blind action only.
Oracle uses paired source clean IQ for diagnostic only; deployable coefficient estimate uses only received IQ and blind-parent forward prediction.
Even and odd samples from same waveform are correlated, so held-out scores are not independent examples and improvement need not imply identification benefit.
Source cohort was previously explored; no TX labels, U_s truth, V or target test.
